visualTheme: abandoned research facility v2 -- fluid higher-frame-count character animation, a deliberately-constructed modular tile atlas, and 8 props (top-down asset-quality overhaul pass)
sourceLicense: MetroForge internally authored/generated research-facility v2 test pack; repository development-only. Character stills reused verbatim from v1 (same real NVIDIA FLUX generations, same API key already authorized/used in this repo) -- only the derived animation sheets were regenerated this pass, at higher frame counts via generateRunCycleSheet/generateAttackSheet/generateHurtFlashSheet/generateDeathSheet. Terrain is a new hand-authored deliberate-construction script (not the shared generateTilesetSource()). Props/interactive/items/VFX use the repo's existing procedural generators. See production-report-animation.json for exact per-character frame counts and real computeFrameQualityMetrics results.
